name: Seri
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Seri (also known as Serah or Zerah) was one of the twin sons of Judah and Tamar. He is known for the red thread that the midwife tied around his hand at birth, even though his twin brother Perez was ultimately born first. Seri became the ancestor of the Zerahites and is mentioned in several genealogies in the Old Testament.

keyEvents.title: The Birth with the Red Thread
keyEvents.description: At birth, Zerah reached out his hand first, and the midwife tied a red thread around it. But his twin brother Perez pushed ahead and was born first.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Zerah is mentioned as a son of Judah in Jacob's family genealogy, among those who went down to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Zerah's Descendants Listed
keyEvents.description: The sons of Zerah are listed as renowned wise men in Israel, including Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy of the Zerahites in the Census
keyEvents.description: In the census recorded in Numbers, the Zerahites are mentioned as one of the clans from the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Achan's Sin Linked to Zerah's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Achan, who took some of the devoted things from Jericho, was a descendant of Zerah through Zimri. His sin brought disaster upon Israel.
